description: This minor course explores various DC and AC converters for renewable energy, PV control schemes for solar energy, and converters for wind energy and wave energy applications.

syllabus.title: AC-DC Converters
syllabus.body: Single phase and three phase controlled and uncontrolled half-wave converter, 2-pulse midpoint converter, half-controlled and fully-controlled bridge converters, effect of load and source impedance, input power factor, displacement factor, harmonic factor and output voltage, effect of free-wheeling diode, triggering circuits, dual converter.

syllabus.title: Power Converters and Analysis of Solar PV Systems
syllabus.body: Line commutated converters (inversion mode), boost and buck-boost converters, selection of inverter, battery and array sizing, simulation of line commutated and buck/boost converters, block diagram of solar PV systems, types of solar PV systems (stand-alone, grid integrated), grid connection issues.

syllabus.title: DC to AC Converters
syllabus.body: Classification, series and parallel inverters, single-phase voltage source inverter and analysis with various types of loads, three-phase voltage source inverter with 180 degree and 120 degree conduction modes, PWM inverters and techniques, reduction of harmonics, voltage regulation in single-phase inverters, single-phase current source inverter, applications in households and industries.

syllabus.title: Multilevel Converters and Inverters
syllabus.body: Introduction to multilevel converters, cascaded H-bridge multilevel converters, output voltage waveform synthesis in the CHB converter, asymmetrical CHB converters, phase-shifted and level-shifted PWM, modular multilevel converters.

outcomes: Describe the basic components of the AC-DC conversion system.
Apply knowledge to solar energy applications.
Identify the significance of DC to DC and DC to AC converters and their design for PV and wind.
Understand multilevel converters and different topologies.
textbooks: P. S. Bhimbra, Power Electronics, Khanna Publishers, 2018.
N. Mohan, T. M. Undeland and W. P. Robbins, Power Electronics: Converters, Applications and Design, 3rd Edition, Wiley India.
Bin Wu and Mehdi Narimani, High-Power Converters and AC Drives, 2nd Edition, Wiley-IEEE Press, 2017.
referenceBooks: Haitham Abu-Rub, Mariusz Malinowski and Kamal Al-Haddad, Power Electronics for Renewable Energy Systems, Transportation and Industrial Applications, 1st Edition, Wiley-IEEE Press, 2016.
